messages:
Elena (Recruiter): Heads-up team  Miguel S accepted for SWE IC, start 2026-04-06. He just messaged me: his EAD card was marked delivered but missing from mailbox. Heiled a lost-card police report and is starting replacement with USCIS. Can we still onboard him 4/6? :grimacing:
Priya - People Ops: Oof. Short: we cannot process paid work without physical work auth. If Miguel has an I-797C receipt showing a replacement EAD filed, we can allow orientation but payroll needs final docs before pay. Legal to confirm what temporary evidence we can accept for I-9.
Jordan R (Payroll): Payroll note: we need either the EAD card or another List A document for I-9. USCIS receipt (I-797C) for replacement is sometimes accepted as temporary but we need Legal sign-off. If timeline misses payroll cutoff we can do retro-pay if docs come before processing close.
Legal-Team: For lost/damaged EADs candidate should file Form I-765 with replacement box checked and keep the I-797C receipt. For I-9, the receipt is acceptable as "receipt of application to replace EAD" if it contains the employee's name and A-number and the employer records the receipt info and follows up with the actual card later. Employer must re-verify when original document arrives. We'll provide wording for the contingent addendum and I-9 instructions.
Miguel S (New Hire): Thanks all 0I filed the replacement online earlier today, uploaded police report and USPS inquiry number to the HR portal. I can also go to the local USCIS field office if that helps. I'm worried about benefits and equity vesting.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Miguel S: usps_inquiry_0426.pdf, police_report_0426.pdf, i765_receipt_screenshot.png (HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: Ok good. Miguel please also upload a clear scan of your passport and a signed acknowledgement of risk for mail issues. We'll draft a contingent start that allows orientation-only access 4/6-4/12 and converts to paid upon receipt of physical EAD or acceptable alternative.
Sam A (Office Admin): If Miguel needs a certified in-person I-9 slot, we can book a same-week appointment at HQ once he has the receipt. Also can issue a temporary badge for building access for orientation.
Jordan R (Payroll): Miguel: FYI if EAD arrives before payroll cutoff (4/18 EOD), we can retro-pay to 4/6. If not, paid wages start on clearance date. Please keep receipts for any premium filing or courier fees 0we can evaluate reimbursement per policy.
Legal-Team: We'll post exact I-9 completion steps here. In short: Employer may accept the I-797C receipt as List A for Form I-9 if it's the receipt for a replacement EAD. The employer must re-inspect the new EAD when it's issued and annotate the I-9. We'll attach a short template for the addendum and an I-9 checklist.
Elena (Recruiter): I'll send Miguel the addendum option: (A) postpone paid start until EAD received, or (B) orientation-only start 4/6 unpaid then convert to paid when card arrives. Hiring manager prefers B. Miguel, which do you prefer?
Miguel S (New Hire): I prefer B 0orientation-only then paid on receipt. I can pay for overnight replacement courier if that helps and submit receipts. Also want to avoid gap in health coverage.
Priya - People Ops: Noted. Health coverage: benefits activation requires payroll enrollment; if we can retro-pay we can make coverage effective on the paid start date retroactively if docs and forms are filed before benefits cutoff. We'll coordinate with Benefits team.
Legal-Team: Draft language (summary): "Employee start date for onboarding: 2026-04-06 (orientation only). Conversion to paid employment contingent upon employers receipt and verification of valid work authorization (EAD card or otherwise acceptable List A document). Employee agrees to provide original documentation promptly and to attend in-person verification. Company will make reasonable efforts to retroactively compensate employee to the orientation start date if documentation is received before payroll cutoff." We'll attach full addendum.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Follow up Miguel EAD replacement" on 2026-04-09 09:00
Jordan R (Payroll): Action items for payroll: hold new hire in provisioning, prepare for retro-pay if cleared, and hold benefits activation until verified. I'll add a note in ADP and tag comp for equity vesting guidance.
Priya - People Ops: Action items:
- Miguel: keep uploading USCIS receipts and courier/tracking; attend in-person I-9 appointment when scheduled.
- Elena: send contingent addendum and ask Miguel to sign; confirm hiring manager.
- Sam: tentatively reserve an I-9 slot and temp badge for 4/6.
- Jordan: flag payroll and benefits for retro-pay path.
Elena (Recruiter): Sending addendum now. Miguel, please review and sign today so we can finalize access.
Miguel S (New Hire): Signed and uploaded the addendum. Thanks everyone 0I'll book courier if USCIS offers replacement fast option.
Priya - People Ops: Great. We'll reconvene after Miguel's replacement EAD arrives. If not received by 4/18 we'll shift paid start per payroll instructions. Closing notes: keep receipts for potential reimbursement and copy Legal on any USCIS escalation requests. :thumbsup:
